VETERAN PAY GUIDE

VA disability payment dates

Match each expected payment with the benefit month it covers. Dates below are calculated, and your bank’s availability may differ.

Source review: October 16, 2026 · How we review content

Payment month and benefit month are different.

Regular compensation is paid after the month it covers. A payment expected in early February covers January. These dates describe recurring payments, not the timing of a first award or back pay.

Expected 2027 payment calendar

This table includes December 2026, the expected first benefit month at the 2027 annual rate, followed by the 12 benefit months of 2027. December 2027 is paid at the end of December because the observed New Year holiday falls on December 31.

Calculated dates, not a VA-published calendar or a deposit guarantee.

Why can a payment arrive early?

When the normal date falls on a weekend or holiday, the scheduled payment moves earlier. That can put two payments in one calendar month and none in the next. It does not create an extra month of benefits: check the benefit-month column to see what each payment covers.

For example, the January 2027 benefit month is expected to be paid on February 1. February’s benefit month is expected on March 1.

How these dates are calculated

We start on the first day after each benefit month and move backward past Saturdays, Sundays, and observed federal holidays. The same date logic powers this table and the homepage calendar. The next-payment indicator uses the U.S. Eastern calendar date.

What if my deposit is different or missing?

A bank’s early-release policy can change when funds appear. A new award, back pay, withholding, or an award adjustment may also follow different timing. First review your VA payment history ↗, then contact VA or your bank through their official channels if you need help.

Do not post bank details, claim numbers, medical records, or other personal information on this website’s public issue tracker.
